title: The agent listens
prompt: Open the song in ~/music/unidaw-short-listen. Put melody.wav from that folder on a new audio track called Melody in the Verse. What key is it in? Then add a soft pad with the 4OSC synth that plays chords in that key under the Verse, and put a little of the built-in reverb on the melody.

captions.text: It hears the key of a recording
